settings.title: Settings
settings.welcomeHint: Go through the first steps again to change where to search and how deep to index.
settings.historyHint: A search is kept when you press Enter or open a result. It stays on this computer.
settings.historyClearConfirm: All search history will be deleted for good.
settings.contentUnavailable: Content indexing status is not available right now.
settings.contentHint: Reads the text of documents in the background so you can search inside them.
settings.shortcutsHint: Changing shortcuts is coming later. These are the current ones:
about.tagline: Instant search for your files, Arabic first.
about.mock: The interface is running on sample data in the browser.
update.title: Updates
update.failed: Couldn't check for updates right now.
update.installConfirm: The update will be downloaded and installed, then Athrix restarts.
update.auto: Check for updates automatically at startup
update.autoHint: This is the only time Athrix connects to the internet. Takes effect at the next start.
mcp.title: MCP / AI assistants
mcp.intro: Lets AI assistants that speak MCP (such as Claude Desktop and Claude Code) search your files through Athrix's index. Read-only: the assistant cannot change, delete or open any file.
mcp.enableWarning: Warning: what the assistant finds or reads may be sent to its cloud service. Turn this on only if you trust the assistant, and allow only the folders it needs.
mcp.noFolders: The server stays off until you add at least one folder.
mcp.foldersHint: The assistant sees only files inside these folders; everything else is hidden from it.
mcp.allowReadHint: Without it the assistant sees file names and search snippets only, never a whole document's text.
mcp.connectHint: Copy the configuration and paste it into claude_desktop_config.json (in Claude Desktop: Settings → Developer → Edit Config), then restart Claude.
mcp.serverMissing: athrix-mcp was not found next to the app (in a dev build, run npm run worker).
update.banner: A new version of Athrix is available:
welcome.title: Welcome to Athrix
welcome.whereBody: Choose the drives to index. The first indexing takes a few minutes, and you can search meanwhile.
welcome.levelBody: Names alone are quick and light. Reading contents lets you search inside documents.
welcome.levelNamesBody: Finds files and folders by name. The fastest and lightest.
welcome.levelContentBody: Reads the text of documents in the background so you can search inside them too.
welcome.levelSmartBody: Search by meaning, not just words.
welcome.levelLater: You can change this later in Settings.
welcome.shortcutBody: Press this shortcut in any app to open the quick search window.
welcome.tipAnywhere: Type a file name or part of it; results appear as you type.
welcome.tipEnter: Enter opens the result; Ctrl+Enter opens its folder.
welcome.tipSettings: Settings are always at hand with Ctrl+,
drives.title: Drives to index
drives.whole: Whole computer (internal and plugged-in external drives)
drives.hint: Indexing whole drives takes a few minutes the first time; search keeps working meanwhile.
drives.offline: Not connected — searched again when plugged back in
drives.includeRemovableHint: USB sticks and memory cards are indexed when plugged in and hidden from results when removed (with "Whole computer").
drives.includeNetworkHint: Mapped network drives can be slow to index and to watch.
drives.includeOnedriveHint: When off, OneDrive folders and their file contents are not indexed and their current results are removed. The index is rebuilt after a change.
search.placeholder: Search for a file, content, or an idea…
scope.label: Search in
filters.label: Filter by type
queryError.UnclosedQuote: The quotation mark " is not closed.
queryError.UnclosedGroup: The group bracket < is not closed.
queryError.DanglingOperator: The operator “{span}” has nothing to apply to.
queryError.InvalidSize: Can't read the size “{span}”. Example: size:>10mb
queryError.InvalidDate: Can't read the date “{span}”. Example: dm:2026-03
queryError.InvalidKind: Unknown type “{span}”. Types: doc, image, video, audio, code, archive, folder
queryError.InvertedRange: The range starts after it ends.
queryError.TooDeep: The brackets are nested too deeply.
queryError.Unsupported: The filter “{span}” isn't supported by name search yet.
interpret.label: Understood as:
settings.interpretAutoHint: Plain sentences such as "photos from last week" are replaced by filters once you stop typing; Esc undoes it. When off, the suggestion only appears under the field.
index.offlineTitle: These drives are unplugged: their files are hidden from results until they are back.
index.mockTitle: Running outside the desktop app: results come from a fake in-browser index.
hints.label: Keyboard shortcuts
empty.title: Find anything on your computer
empty.body: Type part of a name. Arabic search ignores diacritics and hamza forms, so محاضرة finds مُحَاضَرَة.
noResults.title: Nothing found for “{query}”
noResults.hint: Check the spelling, use fewer words, or remove filters.
notReady.title: The index is still being built
notReady.body: Results will appear as soon as indexing finishes.
notReady.errorTitle: Search is unavailable: the index couldn't be built
notReady.errorBody: You can retry from the status bar.
notReady.idleTitle: The index hasn't been built yet
notReady.idleBody: Start indexing to make search available.
notReady.errorHint: Check the chosen drives, then try again.
empty.indexingNote: Indexing is under way. You can start typing now.
noResults.hintSpelling: Check the spelling or the keyboard language, or try fewer words.
noResults.hintLayout: It looks like this was typed with the other keyboard layout.
noResults.hintScoped: The search is limited to one place on your computer.
noResults.hintFiltered: The type filter is hiding other kinds of files.
noResults.hintContent: Only file names were searched, not what's inside them.
queryError.generic: There's a problem in the search syntax at “{span}”.
preview.staleTitle: This result is out of date
preview.staleBody: The index changed since this search; the results are being refreshed.
preview.reason.pdfWorker: The PDF reader component is missing or didn't start, so this file can't be previewed here. Open it in its app.
content.disabledDetail: Search covers file names only. Turn on content indexing below to search inside documents.
content.pausedDetail.user: You paused it. Searching what's already indexed still works.
content.pausedDetail.battery: It resumes on its own when the charger is plugged in.
content.pausedDetail.busy: It resumes on its own when the computer is less busy.
notice.stale: That result is out of date; searching again…
empty.quickHint: Type a name, or use a filter such as ⁨ext:pdf⁩, ⁨type:image⁩ or ⁨size:>100mb⁩
preview.empty: Select a result to preview it here.
preview.truncated: Only the beginning of the file is shown.
preview.meta.label: Details
preview.meta.title: Title
preview.meta.author: Author
preview.reason.format: There's no preview for this type of file.
preview.reason.tooLarge: This file is too large to preview.
preview.reason.corrupt: This file looks damaged, so it can't be previewed.
preview.reason.missing: This file is no longer on the disk.
preview.reason.unreadable: This file couldn't be read (it may be locked or protected).
results.dupeIncompleteTitle: The scan ran out of time before reading every file. Continuing picks up where it stopped.
queryError.DupeNotTopLevel: “{span}” applies to the whole search — use it outside |, ! and < >.
queryError.DupeTakesNoValue: “{span}” takes no value — write it alone, e.g. dupe: ext:jpg
queryError.DupeWithContent: Duplicate search with `content:` needs the content index.
queryError.SimilarNotTopLevel: “{span}” applies to the whole search — use it outside |, ! and < >.
queryError.SimilarRepeated: Use similar: only once in a search.
queryError.SimilarWithDupe: similar: and dupe: can't be combined — use one of them.
queryError.SimilarWithContent: Similar-image search can't be combined with content search yet.
queryError.SimilarReferenceNotFound: No indexed image has this name: “{span}”.
similar.actionTitle: Show images that look like this one
similar.placeholder: Type to start a new search…
similar.badgeGroupTitle: Group {group} — similarity to its first image: {percent}
similar.summaryGroups: Groups of similar images: {groups} · images compared: {checked}
similar.none: None of the indexed images looks like this one.
similar.noneYet: Nothing found yet, and the scan isn't finished. Choose “Continue scan” to complete it.
queryError.ContentInOr: “{span}” can't be combined with | (OR) yet — search each alternative separately.
queryError.NegatedContentGroup: A negated group can't contain “{span}” — negate the content filter itself, e.g. -content:draft.
queryError.OnlyExcludedContent: A query with only “{span}” has nothing to search for — add a word or filter, e.g. ext:docx -content:draft.
content.title: Content indexing
content.runningDetail: Reading files in the background: about {rate} documents per second. Search works meanwhile.
content.searchTooHint: Plain words search names and contents together. The content: filter always searches contents.
